name: Emma Cathriness
source:
Emma "Bunny" Cathriness, italian, ripperdoc, a tough and no nonsense goth girl who's been forced to take care of her sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c156052]Isabella[/url], ever since their father left them after permanently disfiguring Isabella as a young girl and destroying her left eye.

A tough-as-nails girl who cares deeply for her sister and does her best to support her no matter what, even to the point of enabling Isabella's reclusive NEET behaviors.
